criteria.label: Current investing activity
criteria.guidance: met requires recent official evidence of new investments; a website alone is insufficient. inactive is not_met; insufficient recent evidence is unknown.

criteria.label: Accepted institutional investor type
criteria.guidance: not_met for individuals, service providers, portfolio companies, or an excluded investor type.

criteria.label: Sector compatibility
criteria.guidance: Evaluate stated thesis against sector and subsectors; generic innovation language is insufficient.

criteria.label: Investment stage compatibility
criteria.guidance: not_met only when an explicit stage range excludes the startup; absence is unknown.

criteria.label: Geographic compatibility
criteria.guidance: not_met only when an explicit geography excludes incorporation, operations, or target markets as applicable.

criteria.label: Check-size compatibility
criteria.guidance: not_met when verified limits on both sides do not overlap; missing limits are unknown.

criteria.label: Round-type compatibility
criteria.guidance: Evaluate named round types separately from stage.

criteria.label: Business-model compatibility
criteria.guidance: not_met when the investor explicitly excludes the startup's company or business-model type.

criteria.label: Lead/follow compatibility
criteria.guidance: Use met/not_met only with evidence; otherwise unknown or not_applicable when the startup has no stated preference.

criteria.label: Regulatory or thematic restrictions
criteria.guidance: not_met for an explicit applicable restriction; missing information is unknown.

criteria.label: Direct or significant portfolio conflict
criteria.guidance: A conflict is separate from eligibility and does not make the firm ineligible without an explicit exclusion.

criteria.label: Sufficiently recent evidence
criteria.guidance: Historical investment alone does not establish current activity.
